name: bulk-allowsplit
description: Plan 8.1 bulk write row: about 5,000 shapes through apply_operations with allowSplit true, on a fresh page. A call takes at most 2,000 operations, so the run sends 3 calls of 1,667 create_rect operations; `commits` counts change batches (one per 2,000 changes), not file writes; 1,667 rects fit one batch, so each call reports 1 (3 in all). The total is the sum of the three calls; the budget is 25 s p50, 45 s p95, 60 s p99 for the whole 5,000.
